    Finite reflections into a presilting perpendicular #

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_semistable_reflection {R : Type u} [Ring R] [IsArtinianRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (θ : Weight (FGModuleCat R)) (hθ : CovariantlyFinite θ.IsSemistable) (X : FGModuleCat R) :
    ∃ (L : FGModuleCat R) (i : X ⟶ L), θ.IsSemistable L ∧ ∀ (Y : FGModuleCat R), θ.IsSemistable Y → Function.Bijective fun (g : L ⟶ Y) => CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp i g

    A left approximation by semistable modules of least length has unique factorizations, since the kernel of a difference yields another approximation.

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.exists_perpendicular_reflection_of_presilting {R : Type u} [Ring R] [IsArtinianRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (k : Type u) [Field k] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] (P : TwoTerm R) (hp : P.IsPresilting) (X : FGModuleCat R) :
    ∃ (L : FGModuleCat R) (i : X ⟶ L), P.InvertedOn L.obj ∧ ∀ (N : ModuleCat R), P.InvertedOn N → Function.Bijective fun (g : L.obj ⟶ N) => CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp i.hom g

    Every finite module has a finite reflection that remains universal for maps to arbitrary modules inverting the differential.
